'''Chagrians''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] native to the [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Champala/Legends|Champala]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Chagrian_female_LBE.png|thumb|left|150px|A female Chagrian pilot.]]
Chagrians were born as [[Tadpole/Legends|tadpoles]] in clutches of three or more and raised in tubs of water in a family's private home. During this time, their arms, legs, and air-breathing lungs were developed. Adult Chagrians were truly amphibious, retaining their ability to breathe underwater while also able to function without difficulty in air. They also possessed acute low-light vision.

The average Chagrian stood taller than a [[Human/Legends|Human]] with blue skin ranging in tone from light blue to indigo. They were distinguished by two fleshy growths protruding from the sides of their heads, which they called [[Lethorn/Legends|lethorns]]. As they aged, the lethorns would thicken.<ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Males also sported two horns growing from the top of their skulls. These were once used in underwater duels to attract a mate, and were seen as a sign of the males' strength and virility. Females lacked the superior cranial horns, but had more pronounced and longer posterior head plates. These could reach halfway down their back.<ref name="Legacy 34">[[Legacy (2006) 34|''Legacy'' (2006) 34]]</ref> Chagrians also had very long black forked [[Tongue/Legends|tongues]].

Because of frequent exposure to Champala's oceans, Chagrians lost their sense of taste by adulthood although those raised completely off-world did not share this loss. As a result, they regarded eating as an unfortunate nuisance rather than something to be looked forward to and enjoyed. As they had little interest in eating, Chagrians consumed nutritional substances to replace meals. They carried sensors designed to scan for maximum nutritional value when forced to eat actual food.<ref name="LECG" />

Chagrians had a natural resistance to [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]. This dated back to a period of solar instability coinciding with the early evolution of life on Champala. The entire [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was bombarded with intense radiation, and only those lifeforms most able to withstand the bombardment survived.

==Society and culture==
As a species, Chagrians were generally peaceful and law-abiding to the point of becoming stoic and obstinate. Many Chagrians were motivated only by basic desires such as sustenance, shelter, and health-care. Chagrian government ensured that every citizen was cared and provided for, so the standard of living for the poorest Chagrian was high compared to the members of other species.<ref name="LECG" />

Education was valued in Chagrian society and many Chagrians would travel off-world for advanced university studies. Most Champala-based Chagrians did not speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], however those who traveled off-world learned it quickly.

Many Chagrians believed the god-king [[Aram Acheron]] would one day burst forth from [[Logue Rock]] and lead his faithful to victory over their enemies.

During times of war, Chagrians would wear [[Color/Legends|red]].<ref name="TCWCE" /> New Republic lawyer [[Sul Dekkon]] often wore decorative spheres--made of materials such as polished ebonium-on the tips of his [[Lethorn/Legends|lethorns]].<ref name="VOR">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Chagrian_Wave-Skimmer_LBE.png|thumb|left|180px|A Chagrian evading Imperial fire on a [[Wave-skimmer/Legends|wave-skimmer]]]]
Civilization on [[Champala/Legends|Champala]] originated in long strips of coastline, where sea levels fluctuated wildly with the tides. Buildings in these ancient cities were entirely submerged at high tide, and Chagrians swam between them. Some multi-story buildings were not equipped with staircases or elevators at all; inhabitants simply waited until high tide, then swam to higher floors. Once the Chagrians made contact with other species, they constructed starports and trade cities on high plateaus accessible by [[Airspeeder/Legends|aircar]].<ref name="LECG" />

Around five hundred years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], a number of needy Chagrian locals were approached by recruiters sent by [[Hugo Bartyn]]. Bartyn wanted amphibian fishermen to settle a new city in [[Lamaredd/Legends|Lamaredd]] and tempted these poverty-stricken individuals with promises of untouched seas in a new frontier. Once they arrived, however, they became [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] laborers. A few years later, one of these Chagrians, [[Sirrik Olyeg]], founded the [[Sailor's Union]] and was responsible of the liberation of all the slaves.<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], many Chagrians were moved to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. They applied their aquatic expertise to the liberation of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-dominated water worlds and played a major role in [[Calamarian Revolt|liberating]] [[Attack on Mon Calamari|Mon Calamari]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

Champala was one of the first planets to join the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], and later the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and remained a staunch supporter.

Chagrians in the galaxy had many different occupations. [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] served as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] right-hand man during the final years of the Galactic Republic. [[Orso Meeto]] operated as one of the most prominent [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] on the slave [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Orvax IV]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|302|Meeso, Orto}}</ref> [[Sul Dekkon]] was a Chagrian [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]] who [[Trial of Tahiri Veila|prosecuted]] the ex-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahiri Veila]] in [[44 ABY]] as one of his most famous court cases.<ref name="Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> Some Chagrians in Lamaredd obtain certain notoriety, including [[Sirrik Olyeg]]; "[[Bantha/Legends|Bantha]]" [[Burloo]], a large Chagrian [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] at [[Miss Mylla's Saloon]]; and [[Ackrahbala]], also known as "Crazy 'Bala", the manager and owner of [[Ackrahbala's Swoops & Speeders]].<ref name="BL" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Knights of the Old Republic 1|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 1]], there is what appears to be a red skinned Chagrian.
